Class GermanTaxLotEngine

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.tax.germany.GermanTaxLotEngine
public class GermanTaxLotEngine extends Object
Derives the starting values of a tax year for the German tax return from the transactions of a tenant: the gains of sales, the income and the advance lump sums of funds, always in euro and always by FIFO per security account. It is no tax calculation.

The calculation runs beside the one of SecurityGeneralCalc, because it moves lots between security accounts and securities, values everything in euro and applies advance lump sums to lots. It runs once over all transactions from the oldest on, and the report keeps only the sales and income of the tax year.

  • A security account transfer and an ISIN change are one event: the lots of the source move with their purchase time, cost in euro and applied advance lump sums, and no gain arises (BMF letter on individual questions of the flat-rate withholding tax: Rn. 67 for the ISIN change, Rn. 184a for the transferred acquisition data).
  • A sale gains the proceeds after its costs at the rate of the day of the sale, less the cost in euro of the lots it consumed (§ 20 Abs. 4 EStG). The gain of a fund is reduced by the advance lump sums of the units sold (§ 19 Abs. 1 InvStG).
  • The advance lump sum of a fund is calculated at each year end for the units then held and counts as income of the following year (§ 18 InvStG).
  • Purchases before 1 January 2009 (shares and claims) and 1 January 2018 (funds) follow transition rules and appear only in the block LEGACY (§ 52 EStG, § 56 InvStG).

A gap, such as a missing exchange rate, base interest rate or price, never turns into a substitute value. The lot or the booking becomes incomplete, the sums it feeds stay without an amount and a warning names the cause.

  • Method Details

    • firstWorkingDay

      public static LocalDate firstWorkingDay(int year)
      The first working day of a year, on which the advance lump sum of the previous year counts as received (§ 18 Abs. 3 InvStG). The 1 January is a holiday, Saturday and Sunday are no working days. For 2027 it is 4 January.
      Parameters:
      year - the calendar year
      Returns:
      the day

    • calculate

      public GermanTaxYearReport calculate(int taxYear, List<Transaction> securityTransactions, List<Transaction> cashInterest)
      Calculates the report of a tax year.
      Parameters:
      taxYear - the tax year, normally between 2018 and the current year
      securityTransactions - all purchases, sales and dividends of the tenant that belong to a security, the transfer and ISIN change bookings included
      cashInterest - the interest bookings of the cash accounts
      Returns:
      the sums, warnings, unclassified bookings and the derivation
